$comment: NPC Contact's contacts by the cache's npc_contact contact_id (dbtable 130, read by plugins/interface/NpcContact.plugin.js; docs/npc-contact.md). npc is the NPC gameval whose conversation the contact opens. With no variant it is the NPC's own Talk-to, as rsprox captures show for the Slayer masters (1698, 4056, 1146: Turael, Mazchna, Duradel, Nieve answer "'Ello, and what are you after then?"). variant names the Wiki transcript's astral-contact conversation where the NPC has one and no capture contradicts it.
